entities.summary: Maciej Marian Giertych is a Polish dendrologist and former right wing politician of the League of Polish Families (LPR). He favours state intervention in the economy. He was a member of the Sejm and a Polish member of the European Parliament. He was a candidate in the 2005 Polish presidential elections, but withdrew from the race because of low vote results. He is a notable creationist. Maciej Giertych was a writers & intellectuals from Warsaw (b. 1936-03-24, Warsaw). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
